subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (ii) Jalaluddin Mohammad Akbar was one of the most famous rulers of the Mughal dynasty. (b) + (vi) He was the son of Humayun and grandson of Babor. (c) + (iv) Though he had formal education, he ascended to the throne of Delhi at the age of 13 only and successfully ruled for more than 50 years in India. (d) + (i) Though not formally educated, he acquired the warfare skill and basing on it, won the 2nd Panipath Battle in 1556. (e) + (iii) It was indeed the greatest victory in in 1542 at Amarkot in Sindh.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 89 — Feni Govt. Pilot High School
